BP(Vet) 2008 (Ronidazole). A white to yellowish-brown, odourless or almost odourless powder. Slightly soluble in water, in alcohol, and in chloroform; very slightly soluble in ether. Pro- tect from light. Profile Ronidazole is a 5-nitroimidazole antiprotozoal that is used in vet- erinary practice for the control of trichomoniasis in cage birds and pigeons. It has also been added to turkey feeding stuffs and has been used for the control of swine dysentery.
